+1 to Samira's questions — adding clarifying bullets and the proposed session cadence.

One-line definitions (for calibration use):
- Commit: Legal-signed contract OR customer PO received AND internal readiness (assigned AE + delivery owner) confirmed.
- Best Case: Executed SOW pending signature OR strong verbal yes with documented acceptance criteria; requires evidence (email chain + clear next step).
- Pipeline: Early-stage opportunities without documented acceptance, budget sign, or committed delivery timeline.

Invoice/PO guidance: if invoice sent but PO not received, keep as Best Case only if customer has signed (email confirmation) or finance has record of committed spend. Otherwise, Pipeline.

Calibration sessions (pick one):
- Tue 2027-06-08 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue 2027-06-08 15:00–15:30 PT
- Wed 2027-06-09 09:00–09:30 PT

I'll join the call to walk through the top 8 deals and show the example tagging table (see attached slides). Please paste top HubSpot deal IDs in your reply or add them directly to the shared sheet in the Drive link.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Revenue Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
